learn.title: Learn
learn.lead: Read it, then check it in the sky. The sky follows along.
learn.notTranslated: This lesson is not translated yet, so it is shown in Korean.

trackDesc.principle: Questions you can only answer by winding time. Why the constellations change with the season, the phases of the Moon, the backward loops of the planets.
trackDesc.target: Things you can actually find tonight. Star by star, from the bright ones down to clusters, nebulae and galaxies.
trackDesc.measure: How people worked it out. The ways we learned to measure brightness, colour and distance.

portal.headline: Learn to read the night sky
portal.lead: Read the explanation, then check it in the sky right above. The sky on screen is the real sky where you are, so you can go outside tonight and find it yourself.
portal.tonightLead: These sit well in the sky this time of year. Read one, walk outside, and it is there.
portal.how1Title: A real sky on the left
portal.how1Body: The sky on screen is the real sky above you. You can drag it, spin it and tap other stars while you read.
portal.how2Title: The sky moves with the text
portal.how2Body: The view swings around, zooms in, constellation art switches on, time runs hundreds of times faster. Like a teacher turning the dome in a planetarium.
portal.how3Body: Every lesson ends with something to do tonight with your own eyes. A lesson that ends on the screen is a planetarium, not observing.
portal.footNonprofit: Byeolmuri is a non-profit open source project with no ads and no tracking.
